title: Cars, Trucks & Engines
content:
Cars, Trucks & Engines
You may have passed the test for your driver's license, but that doesn't mean you'll ace our quizzes about all things auto. Buckle up, because we're about to test your auto knowledge.
Learn More
From hook turns to roundabouts, Australia has a number of interesting road rules and conditions. How will you fare in this quiz on Aussie road rules? Test your knowledge on our wacky road rules!
By Hania Syed
A movie can create a magical escape from reality, with elaborate storylines and top-notch acting. Alternatively, the acting can be garbage, but the car chases are worth watching the movie. Can you identify these movies by the cars that made them awesome?
By Nikki Weed
Truck yeah! These marvelous machines have been a pillar of hard-working people for as long as Texaco has sold gas. Can you tell a Hudson from an International or a Willys from a Dodge? Take a cruise and try to ace identifying all of these trucks. We promise you won't get muddy!
By Nikki Weed
Advertisement
Every day on the streets around your home or workplace you pass a few hundred cars. Whether it's a Camry, a Corolla, a Cruze or a Continental, let's see how many of these everyday cars you can recognize!
By Ian Fortey
Have you been shopping for a fresh new ride to replace your jalopy but are uncertain what to buy? Instead of wasting your time scouring sites like Carvana, why don't you take our quiz and let us predict what new car you should buy! Who knows, you might be a Camry person after all!
By Nikki Weed
Whether you're a fan of the sleek Italian design of a Lancia Aurelia, the refined British style of a Bentley R-Type or the American muscle of a Chevy Corvette, the '50s were a decade of amazing automobiles. Cruise into the quiz and see what you know about them!
By Ian Fortey
What makes a cool car? Is it how well it performs? The technology that lies underneath? Or maybe how rare it is? Take this personality quiz and we'll guess the coolest car that you've ever driven.
By Robert Bacon
Advertisement
Everyone loves the way a car looks when it's coming but sometimes they can look just as cool going. Can you tell a Camry from a Camaro based on tail pipes alone? Take the quiz and see!
By Ian Fortey
When you see linked rings, do you think of the Olympic Games or Audi? If it's the latter, you might be in with a chance of acing this quiz. What are you waiting for? Test your knowledge now!
By Robert Bacon
What's more fun than an obstacle course? How about maneuvering through an elaborately planned track in a parking lot, set up with cones while trying to go as fast as possible in your very own car? Welcome to the exciting world of autocross! How many of these masters of autocross can you name?
By Nikki Weed
If you drive a McLaren, everyone would be starin', and a Bugatti just feels naughty. A Zonda tops a Honda, and Ferrari is like a party. You won't get pouty for an Audi but that Gallardo will get you far, though. Pick your supercar, and we'll guess your speed limit!
By Ian Fortey
Advertisement
The automotive world has become saturated with hybrids all of a sudden, but can you tell a real hybrid from its gas-powered cohorts? Take a spin through this quiz to see if you can tell the difference! It's not as easy as you think!
By Nikki Weed
If you're one of the lucky ones, your garage is full of fresh metal. If you're not, then you probably agonize over what your next purchase should be. So let's make that decision a bit easier by taking this quiz now!
By Robert Bacon
From duct-taped hoses to pantyhose belts to a little bit of toothpaste on the headlights to keep them shining bright, if you know your roadside emergency fixes, then bust out that roll of duct tape and take the quiz.
By Ian Fortey
The automobile is one of the most important inventions in recent history, changing how the world travels, expanding civilizations, and giving power to the people. How much do you know about its impact? Take this quiz about some of the best-selling vehicles to find out!
By Ruby Scalera
Advertisement
Do you love spending your weekends off the beaten track or building the perfect vehicle to take on the tough trails? This is the quiz for you - put your off-road knowledge to the test and see if you're an expert!
By Ruby Scalera
Are you the person your friends turn to when they have a car-related question? Maybe you're not the one, but you think you should be. Take this quiz and see if you're smarter than your average driver!
By Robert Bacon
Oh, the pistons connect to the crankshaft! The crankshaft connects to the transmission! The transmission connects to engine! And the engine makes the whole car go! Think you can finish mapping all these car parts? Tune up this quiz and see!
By Ian Fortey
If you were going to check out "Star Wars" at the drive-in back in 1977, would you have rolled up in your Oldsmobile Toronado or a sleek Alfa Romeo Spider? There were lots of cars to choose from, so hop in your time machine and see which ones you remember!
By Ian Fortey
Advertisement
How can you tell if this quiz is for you? If we say Alfa Romeo 6C 2500 Freccio D'Oro and it's not just gibberish, then you may be ready to ID some of the fastest cars of the Flyin' Forties. Take the quiz and see!
By Ian Fortey
Are you a car person trapped in a truck body? Take our quiz to find out what vehicle you should be driving! You might find yourself rushing to the nearest car dealership and trading yours in ASAP!
By Nikki Weed
Whether you're on the search for a souped-up pickup truck or a classic American muscle car, take this quiz to find out the perfect time to start searching for your dream car - and planning that first epic drive.
By Ruby Scalera
There's a reason NASCAR is one of the most beloved American sports. It's a tradition, and one shared among families for generations. It's exciting, fun, and full of memories. Think you have what it takes to best this NASCAR history quiz? Try it today!
By Ruby Scalera
Advertisement
When you lift the hood of your car, do you see a finely tuned piece of machinery made up of pistons and cylinders, or just a jumble of metal and wires? If you know an engine like the back of your own hand, take the quiz and prove it!
By Ian Fortey
The right car in a film can make a larger impact than the actor driving it! Can you identify these cars from the movies that made them famous (or semi-famous)?
By Nikki Weed
